About Faire 
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
 About the Role: 
 The Ads Supply pod grows Faire's Ads business by expanding where, how, and in what format ads show up. Almost all of Faire's ads today are promoted product listings, and we'll unlock top-of-market opportunities for our advertisers with premium creative formats.
 As a technical leader, you'll own building the high-scale, low-latency systems that serve and render premium formats like video and brand creative across every surface and device. Working hands-on across the full stack and co-shaping the experience with Product and Design, you'll unify creative serving, formats, and rendering into one cohesive system, partnering closely with Ads Delivery and Ads Bidding and enabling fast, measurable experimentation. You'll also set the technical direction for ad formats at Faire and shape the roadmap for what we build next.
 What You'll Do: 
 Own the technical vision: Define the end-to-end architecture for our next-generation ad formats, including a unified serving layer that keeps the experience fast, scalable, and reliable across surfaces and devices.
 Build the systems behind every format: Design highly automated systems for ad format serving, optimization, and A/B testing that maximize business outcomes.
 Lay the foundations for future formats: Build the framework-level solutions that make new formats faster to ship and deepen how well we understand our users.
 Invent what comes next: Conceptualize, prototype, and run experiments on new ad format ideas, drawing on market trends, user behavior, and advertiser needs to find the opportunities with real business impact.
 Drive cross-functional impact: Operate as a product builder who brings customer understanding to the work, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other engineering teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact solutions.
 Raise the engineering bar: Advocate for and apply best practices across availability, scalability, operational excellence, and cost management.
 Mentor and lead: Guide and upskill other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
 Qualifications: 
 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 3+ years as a technical leader driving complex, cross-team projects.
 Deep expertise in building and scaling ad formats or similar user-facing content delivery systems.
 Excellent programming and system design skills, with a proven track record of leading and operating highly available, high-performance, low-latency backend systems at scale.
 AI-native, using modern AI tooling as a core part of how you deliver impact and embedding AI best practices into your daily workflow.
 A product builder who understands customers deeply, helps shape what gets built, and turns ambiguous business problems into clear product and technical direction.
 Strong collaboration, mentorship, and leadership: a compelling vision, clear communication, and the ability to drive concurrent projects and influence strategy with a collaborative leadership style.
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with cross-platform development.
 Prior experience building or operating creative serving infrastructure for digital advertising, especially for new and rich ad formats (e.g., video or interactive creative).
 Experience with machine learning and gen-AI in advertising, such as ranking, retrieval, and optimization.
 Technologies we use and teach: 
 Backend: Kotlin, Java 16, Hibernate, Guice, Jersey
 Search and data: Elasticsearch, FAISS, Redis, DynamoDB
 Communication: Protocol Buffers, HTTP, JSON
 Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Buildkite, Datadog

 Canada: the pay range for this role is $190,500 - $262,000 per year.

This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.
 We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.
 The mission of this role
 Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
 Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
 Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
 Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
 Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
 Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
 AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
 No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day
 Key Objectives
 Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
 Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
 Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
 Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
 Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
 Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
 Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Fluent in English
 CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must.
 Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up.
 Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages.
 Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help.
 Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency.

Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend. We're trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend. We're looking for a driven, systems-minded, and execution-focused GTM Campaign Manager to join us on our journey.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a GTM Campaign Manager, you will architect and operate the campaign systems that convert pipeline strategy into pipeline reality. Working directly under GTM Engineering, you'll build, launch, and continuously optimize the campaigns and targeted lists that feed our go-to-market teams — across every source of pipeline: inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion (cross-sell/upsell).



Think of this role as a regulator's right hand. Procurify's pipeline comes from multiple, interdependent sources, and the business's #1 constraint is total pipeline coverage against our revenue targets. Rather than owning any single channel in isolation, you'll help balance effort dynamically across all of them — surging outbound when inbound softens, activating expansion campaigns against the install base, and calibrating targeting by segment so we maximize total pipeline, not just one number.



We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why a campaign, list, or process exists, breaking it down to its fundamentals, and rebuilding it in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. This is not a role for someone who runs one-off campaigns and moves on. We want a systems thinker who sees how targeting, data, messaging, and channels connect — and who designs campaign engines that compound in value over time rather than resetting from zero every quarter. The best campaign is often the one you can systematize and automate away.



This role also sits at the intersection of campaign execution and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual list-building, generate and personalize outreach at scale, surface which segments and plays are converting, and free human effort for the highest-leverage pipeline. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is one you can automate, you'll thrive here.



We're also looking for someone relentless about the "last mile." Strategy without clean execution and closed-loop communication is worthless — the difference between a booked meeting and a lead sitting untouched. You'll own that last mile as a system: build the list, launch the campaign, hand it off cleanly, communicate it clearly, and measure what actually happened — then feed those learnings back into the engine.



This is not a systems-administration role (that's RevOps), a people-management role (that's BDR leadership), or a strategy-and-budget role (that's Demand Gen leadership). This is the connective tissue that all of those functions rely on but none of them owns: turning targeting, positioning, systems, and AI into campaigns that drive real pipeline.




WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON:




CAMPAIGN SYSTEMS ACROSS ALL PIPELINE SOURCES

 - Design and operate repeatable, scalable campaign systems — not one-offs — that generate pipeline across inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion.

 - Build and deliver targeted, ICP-aligned lead lists to BDRs proactively and on a repeatable cadence — increasingly automated and AI-generated — as the single most reliable driver of booked meetings.

 - Design, launch, and optimize outbound campaigns end-to-end for both new-business and expansion pipeline, using automation and AI to scale personalization and volume without sacrificing quality.

 - Support inbound performance by iterating and building on systems that improve MQL→SQL conversion.

 - Build expansion (cross-sell/upsell) campaign systems against the existing customer base in partnership with Customer Success and Account Management — a large, under-served pipeline source today.

 - Calibrate campaign targeting by tier/segment (SMB vs. mid-market) to protect and maximize total pipeline, not just a single tier.
   
   


PIPELINE COVERAGE & REBALANCING (UNDER GTM LEADERSHIP)

 - Help monitor pipeline coverage across all sources as a connected system, and reallocate campaign effort to the highest-leverage source as conditions shift.

 - Work from the operational math: track conversion rates by source (MQL→SAL→SQL→pipeline $), model where the leverage is, and use data and automation to drive proactive intervention through GTM led efforts.

 - Flag pipeline softness early, so the business can compensate proactively rather than discovering gaps a quarter too late.
   
   


AI, AUTOMATION & FIRST-PRINCIPLES OPTIMIZATION

 - Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how campaigns are built, launched, and handed off — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value plays.

 - Champion AI and automation across the campaign lifecycle: list generation, enrichment, segmentation, message personalization, sequence optimization, and performance analysis.

 - Continuously deconstruct and rebuild campaign processes to be faster, simpler, and more scalable as we grow.
   
   


LAST-MILE OWNERSHIP & CLOSED-LOOP EXECUTION

 - Ensure clean, automated hand-offs to BDRs and AEs — leads loaded, listed, assigned, and communicated so nothing sits un-worked.

 - Support data fidelity across platforms (Salesforce, Marketo, sequencing, enrichment tools) as a power user of the systems RevOps builds.

 - Define and track measurable outcomes per campaign and per source (SAL, SQL, pipeline $) so "what good looks like" is always explicit — and feed learnings back into the system.
   
   


COLLABORATION & CROSS-SYSTEM ALIGNMENT

 - Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales, BDR leadership, and Customer Success to align targeting, messaging, and campaign execution across the funnel.

 - Apply existing positioning and personas to concrete targeting — and flag when segment/positioning shifts appear to be suppressing high-converting traffic.

 - Work cleanly across teams without owning any of their core mandates — you are the systems builder and connector, not the administrator or the people manager.
   
   


KPIS FOR SUCCESS

 - Increased qualified pipeline creation across all sources (inbound, outbound, tier, expansion), measured in SQLs and pipeline $ — accelerated by AI and automation.

 - Consistent, proactive delivery of high-quality targeted lists to BDRs and AE’s — with measurable lift in meeting production.

 - Improved conversion efficiency across the funnel (session→MQL, MQL→SQL, SAL→SQL).

 - Growth in expansion/upsell pipeline generated through structured, repeatable campaign systems.

 - Reduced manual effort per campaign through automation and systematization.

 - Zero leads lost to poor hand-off — clean, closed-loop execution with no items sitting un-worked.

 - Early, accurate surfacing of pipeline-coverage risk against targets.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 1–3 years in a campaign management, demand generation, sales development, or GTM operations role (or a sharp, high-potential candidate ready to grow into it under mentorship).

 - A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.

 - A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify pipeline output.

 - ICP, persona, and tier fluency — able to independently determine who to target and why, and translate positioning into executable campaign systems.

 - Quantitatively strong — can track conversion rates and pipeline coverage across sources and understand where the leverage is (this is a math + systems + execution role, not execution alone).

 - Proactive, closed-loop communicator — flags blockers early and asks for help rather than silently stalling.

 - Comfortable rebalancing priorities as conditions change; thrives in ambiguity with strong organization.

 - Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce) and sales/marketing automation (Marketo, Outreach/sequencing, enrichment tools like ZoomInfo/Clay).

 - Strong project management, organization, and communication skills, with an impeccable eye for detail.

 - Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Clay, ZoomInfo, AI/automation tooling, or enablement platforms.
   
   

For customer-facing or GTM roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?




HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 Responsibilities
 Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
 Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
 Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
 Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
 Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.

 Collaborate closely with Designers, Concept Artists, Art Directors, Technical Artists, Engineers, Animators, Audio Designers, and Producers.

 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.

 Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

 Houdini experience.

 Unity experience.
 Substance Designer experience.

 Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
 Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.

Salary: $120,000 to $140,000 CAD
Location: Canada based.
About Fiscal.ai 
 Fiscal.ai is a leading research and data platform built for capital markets professionals. Combining a high-performance research Terminal with a modern, near-real-time fundamentals API and MCP server, Fiscal.ai is redefining financial data infrastructure for the AI era. The company serves thousands of institutional and professional Clients while reaching millions of end-users through API Clients.
 The Role 
 The Fiscal.ai Terminal is used every day by thousands of investors to research companies: financial statements, segments and KPIs, estimates, ownership and insider activity, filings, valuation models, screening, and charting. When a chart won't load, a screen returns the wrong companies, or a paywalled cell unlocks for the wrong tier, our users notice immediately, because they know exactly how the product should behave.
 You will own the quality of the Terminal. This is an engineering role, not a QA analyst role. You will find bugs, reproduce them, trace them to root cause across the frontend and backend, and ship the fix yourself. You will build the end-to-end test framework that stops those bugs from coming back. You will work alongside the engineers building the Terminal and the Fiscal.ai data infrastructure.
 If you think this is the perfect fit for you, we'd love to hear specifically why, and which bug in a financial product you are proudest of having found and fixed.
Key Responsibilities 
 Own the inbound bug pipeline for the Terminal, including Sentry issues, customer-reported problems, and what you find yourself. Reproduce, prioritize, and fix or route every one of them.
 Fix bugs across the stack: the React/Next.js frontend, the Cloudflare Workers backend, and the data layer between them. Investigate to the root cause and never patch the symptom.
 Design and build the end-to-end test framework for the Terminal using Playwright, get it running in CI against preview deploys, and grow regression coverage of the flows that matter most: financials, charting, screener, portfolio, auth, subscriptions, and paywall.
 Write unit and integration tests alongside your fixes so the same class of bug cannot ship twice.
 Turn what you learn into playbooks, including debugging guides, test conventions, and tooling the rest of the team uses.
 You write good code, fast, and you fix what you find. If you want to file tickets for someone else to fix, this is not the role.
 Proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
 Hands-on experience building end-to-end test automation (Playwright preferred) and unit tests (Vitest or Jest), and running them in CI.
 Strong debugging skills across the full stack: browser devtools, network traces, server logs, error monitoring, and database queries.
 Experience testing and debugging data-heavy applications where correctness matters, such as finance, analytics, or similar.
 Proven experience or strong interest in investing and finance. Our platform is built by investors, for investors. You should be able to read an income statement, know what LTM and NTM mean, and recognize when a P/E ratio or free cash flow figure is obviously wrong. Ideally you already use Fiscal.ai, or a competing terminal, for your own research.
 Understanding of how paid data products work, including subscription tiers, entitlements, and paywalls.
 Experience or interest in AI technologies, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), including using AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow.
 A keen eye for design, UI, and UX. You notice the misaligned column and the layout shift.
 Based in Canada.
 Nice to Haves
 Python (our data pipeline is written in it).
 Cloudflare Workers, Firebase/Firestore, and PostgreSQL.
 Highcharts or other charting libraries.
 Finance coursework, CFA progress, or professional investing experience.
 Tech Stack
 We work with a diverse set of tools and technologies, including:
 Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Mantine
 Backend and data: Cloudflare Workers, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Firestore
 Testing and CI: Playwright, Vitest, GitHub Actions
 Observability: Sentry, PostHog, Linear

 Equity

 - Own a book of 7,000+ Scaled customers, guiding them through the lifecycle with one-to-many strategies: human-led webinars, email automation, digital touchpoints, high-impact 1:1 outreach, and community channels. You're one of the faces of the motion.

Why You Should Join
